column1: # noite plan: units, function assignments, hand-set statuses, manual unit deps.
# Generated by `noite plan export` (automatic on main); apply with `noite plan apply`.

column5: SceneObject slots 2C-33 3A 3C (frames, play, stopAndRedraw(Dc), tick incl. the Exit's, stop, getTimerId, isRunning), AnimationVtbl 00-05, animation_set_strip, exit_has_key_object
the WinG shell: WinMain, app_init, AppWndProc (the 0x40c re-posting until NOITE's 0x40a, the 0x40b hello and variant, timer 10; BUGS.md J7), message loop, paint
Backdrop (WinG surface, palette, background, autoscroll) and its BackdropVtbl defaults
DIB loading and copies, the RLE blit; the row blitters 1000:0148/0234 are NOITE's (src/dib.zig)
JardimGame + Game: ctor/dtor, GameVtbl 01-06 (createPlayer: the hidden Player; the panel; no status bar; Phase1Scene), game_init, game_take_exit, the conditions
game_handle_message (GameVtbl 00: the engine default under the labyrinth, live only for 0x402) and the Portable pick-up/drop it calls
the minimap (walls, the player square, the panel refresh) and the HUD (level, ammo, health, score, lives, the face, the control panel strip)
the labyrinth's map: the 80 rows of walls and of objects, raymapN.dat, placing and removing an object
LabyrinthBackdrop: ctor, create (BackdropVtbl slot 00: tables, map, start, timer 1), paint, a frame (sky and floor, walls, sprites, hands, HUD), blit to the window
LabyrinthBackdrop slot 17 handleMessage (the keys, the 55-ms tick, the shot, doors, the result 0x40a; BUGS.md J1, J6) and labyrinth_move_and_render (a step and its collisions)

LabyrinthScene: ctor, create, its handler (the 0x402 carry to the next phase), the respawn (slot 17); the three phase ctors (each sets its phase's vtable) and createScreen (the LabyrinthBackdrop on opcaoN.bmp)
ObjectList, DrawList, UpdateList
SceneObject slots 34-39 3B (moveTo, edges, stopMoving(Dc), moveTick, isMoving), MoverVtbl placeAt
constructors and destructors of the objects (SceneObject, WallStrip, Portable, Exit, Player, ControlPanel and their bases), object_list_delete_all, frames
SceneObject slots 27-2B (occupy, vacate, attach incl. the wall strip's, canStep, isStepBlocked) and reattach
ControlPanel (ControlPanelVtbl 06-0D) and StatusBar methods, the inventory icons (portable_draw_icon): created, never shown
Phase1Scene (raymap1): create (objects, MCI music, WaveMix), placeObjects, touch, hit, the sounds, onLifeLost, its handler (exit doors, the scream's end), createNewScene (Phase2Scene); BUGS.md J3, J6
Phase2Scene (raymap2): as phase1; createNewScene builds Phase3Scene; BUGS.md J3, J6
Phase3Scene (raymap3): as phase1 without an exit door; the final enemy (the variant's picture) and the win; BUGS.md J2, J3, J6

SceneObject slots 00-04 (slot00/01, RLE, scene name), 0D-11 getX/getY/getStep, 3E setPosition, 3F/40 scroll target, 54-57 overlaps, 5A/5B exit slots, 5C-60 defaults; the out-of-line accessors; next_object_id, message_box_printf

the walls: raycast_render_view (120 columns, the two ray walks, the nearer hit, the column height and depth), the 32-bit walks 1008:0024/1010:0024 (transcribed, oracle-tested) and their 16:32 gateways, the four wall/door column drawers
SceneObject slots 17-1F (dirty rects, overlap, restore background, drawDirtyTo, draw incl. the panel's and its texts, drawClip(To), erase, slot1F), the DC hooks, reset_rects

the scaled DIB copies: dib_blit_scaled_column and dib_stretch_copy_transparent with their 32-bit cores 1000:0024 (wall column, depth shading) and 1018:0024 (transparent sprite stretch; BUGS.md J5), transcribed and oracle-tested
Scene methods (SceneVtbl 01-04 06 08-0F), ctor, scene_create, the destructor, exits and their links
WaveMix: init, open, play, stop all, free, activate, close
SceneObject slots 05-0C 12-16 3D (Object3D getters and setters, drawBounds, moveToAndDrop) and the Object3DVtbl slots, the perspective math
the sprite queue (the depth tree of up to 100 nodes: insert, draw farthest first, flush) and labyrinth_draw_sprite_entry (projection, clipping by the column depths, the enemies' attack and step)
the trigonometric tables: raycast_build_tables (its 7 tables precomputed bit-exact, src/jardim/tables.bin from tools/jardim_tables.py, checked against the oracle) and raycast_angle_to_radians
SceneObject slots 20-26 (redraw, hideAndInvalidate, blitToDc, invalidate, slot24, hide, show) and 53 redrawOverlapping
